scope: Actual shared C source with five real all-retaining predicates creates six Steps. Exact frozen DOM/CDP anatomy at four100/150 wide/narrow viewports, trusted independent/reversed nested wheel, partial55-row clipped registry/outline, sticky title, clipped-away Edit inertness, actual End/context Cancel and Collapse/reopen zero-offset lifetime preserve source/pages/history/selection/clipboard with zero post-setup jobs. Every default/reopened compositor crop requires actual neutral title, two icon, detail-title and description ink. At short150 outer/inner end and partial-row states, exact same-header hashes and translated neutral-ink bitmaps retain the unchanged real selected Step; inner/partial/frozen states then retain exact same-position detail RGBA against the observed outer-end baseline; the partial-row frozen hover captures those same five ink regions alongside the original four purple outline strips in one compositor frame. Measurements precede assertions; no tolerance or inferred blank-header product fix. Body Edit/Preview/footer reachability uses frozen semantic capture/cancel; none is activated. No DOM state injection, new C export, native/browser physical input, clipboard activation, saved reports or universal UI parity claim.
limitation: The specified CSS-transformed compositor mapping is accepted. Translated detail preserves exact neutral bitmap; full translated RGBA remains excluded after an earlier nine-pixel one-channel difference. Same-position header/detail RGBA and actual outer-end baseline are checked without tolerance. Arbitrary transforms and physical pixels remain excluded.
